name: Portfolio - Monday.com Project Operations Control Center
description: API-safe starter contract for Project 02. Monday.com remains the operating interface while n8n handles cross-board validation, session control, approval/cost posting, reconciliation, and audit orchestration.

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; if(!b.action) throw new Error('action is required'); const allowed=['health.check','task.validate','task.sync','project.sync','session.start','session.pause','session.resume','session.stop','revision.create','revision.update','timesheet.build','timesheet.submit','timesheet.approve','timesheet.return','rate.resolve','ledger.post','escalation.create','escalation.clear','dashboard.refresh','reconciliation.run','automation.retry']; if(!allowed.includes(b.action)) throw new Error(`Unsupported action: ${b.action}`); return [{json:{...b,project:b.project||'monday-project-ops',requestId:b.requestId||$execution.id,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString(),payload:b.payload||{}}}];

const b=$json; const p=b.payload; const entityId=p.sessionId||p.timesheetId||p.revisionId||p.itemId||p.projectId||b.requestId; const result={operation:b.action,sourceBoard:p.sourceBoard||null,targetBoard:p.targetBoard||null,itemId:p.itemId||null,projectId:p.projectId||null,entityId,deduplicationKey:p.idempotencyKey||`${b.action}:${entityId}`,correlationId:p.correlationId||b.requestId,logRecord:{executionId:$execution.id,status:'Successful',workflow:'Monday.com Project Operations Control Center',requestId:b.requestId,correlationId:p.correlationId||b.requestId}}; return [{json:{...b,result}}];

return [{json:{ok:true,executionId:$execution.id,action:$json.action,status:'accepted',message:'Project 02 request validated. Production Monday.com nodes will be attached to the matching workflow family.',result:$json.result}}];
